hero.bannerAlt: Gem-org — build your react based app with gem-org system
hero.lead: Gem-org offers a design system, transitions and animations for React, easy to use and include in all your projects.

packages.title: What you need to build your components
packages.description: The Gem-org ecosystem: a base design system, visual effects and transitions.

system.description: Ready-to-use, easy-to-customize React + TypeScript components: forms, navigation, feedback, data and more.

effects.description: Visual effects: glow, float, tilt, beams, gradients and motion for product surfaces.

motions.description: Transitions and presence: fade, slide, stagger, morph and animated numbers.

reasons.title: Why use Gem-org?
reasons.description: A docs and API experience designed for building components with a wide range of features.

api.title: Consistent API
api.body: Shared styles across the components gem-system offers, such as forms, overlays, feedback and more.

tokens.title: Semantic tokens
tokens.body: Color, spacing, type and shadow via --gem-*. Light and dark without loose hex values.

docs.title: Detailed docs
docs.body: Every component demo shows detailed examples of its features, making it easier to understand and apply.

motion.title: Effects and motion
motion.body: Gemffects and Gemsitions build on the same ecosystem for presence and detail.

explore.title: Ready to explore
explore.description: The docs have live demos aligned with Storybook, with each component and how to use it.
